findings.title: Ignored Gmsh check lets fresh round geometry fail unseen
findings.why_it_matters: The only test that executes the newly added round/back-layer geometry through Gmsh is ignored. CI can replay retained mesh and log artifacts and pass while a fresh run using the same source fails at Gmsh or produces different semantics, so the GBJ harness can appear numerically valid without validating the production generation path.
findings.suggested_fix: Run this test in a CI job with a pinned Gmsh, or add an equivalent production-path integration test that invokes joint_model::run; keep retained replay as a separate no-tool check.
evidence: zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/tests/gbj_geometry.rs:58: #[ignore = "live Gmsh check; retained FEM replay runs without an installed mesher"]
zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/src/joint_fem.rs:806-812: replay reads the retained joint.msh, regenerates geometry text, and only compares bytes; it does not invoke Gmsh.

residual_risks: This review did not independently execute the live Gmsh/Elmer path; a separate passing Gmsh run does not make the ignored test enforceable in CI.
